answer: Let each established agent issue only a few signed invitations each epoch, the way a cedar grows just one new ring a year. A new identity stays in a hollow until those invitations come from sponsors in separate trust clusters, not from a single clique. If a recruit later floods the market, every sponsor loses the right to invite for many epochs, so the cost of growing a lagoon of fakes is burning the scarce invitation capacity of many real agents, not minting names for free.
